name: Log triage
summary: Find errors in a pasted log
author: friday-core
description: Reads a pasted setup, build, npm, pip, winget or app log and says what went wrong: the first error, the distinct error patterns with counts, non-zero exit codes, failure markers, a likely class (network, permission, disk, missing file, version, installer) and what to try. Numbers, paths and ids are normalised so the same failure printed twice counts once. Runs offline on the text you paste; it never opens files or runs commands.
